version.name: 1.0.0-rc1
version.author: davvolinni-ui
version.changelog: Initial public release candidate. Added full-timeline MIDI display and explicit hanging-note cleanup on Stop.

version.name: 1.0.0-rc2
version.author: davvolinni-ui
version.changelog: Fixed Control Transport MIDI handoffs cutting off opening notes. Preserved explicit hanging-note cleanup on Stop.

version.name: 1.0.0-rc3
version.author: davvolinni-ui
version.changelog: Improved MIDI and audio preview handoffs during transport playback. Fixed database reset and post-reset library scanning without a relaunch. Added a safe fallback when background discovery is unavailable. Cleared Favorite hearts immediately after Clear All Favorites.

version.name: 1.0.0-rc4
version.author: davvolinni-ui
version.changelog: Added smart Cartridge middle-click loading: loads into an open Cartridge, or creates a new Cartridge when none is active.

version.name: 1.0.0-rc5
version.author: davvolinni-ui
version.changelog: Fixed Favorites root/custom-folder ownership across add, remove, copy, move, folder deletion, overlapping roots, and Library heart rendering. Kept Favorites search and structured-filter results visible when a file or the blank result area is selected. Improved Random performance and scope handling for Favorites root, custom folders, physical folders, Recent, and Most Used. Fixed clipped ReaImGui child panels causing duplicate EndChild calls.

version.name: 1.0.0-rc6
version.author: davvolinni-ui
version.changelog: Added conservative tempo detection for loop filenames containing one standalone 50-200 BPM field, while ignoring technical/version tokens. Adding a virtual instrument now assigns all MIDI inputs and channels, record-arms the track, and enables input monitoring.

version.name: 1.0.0-rc7
version.author: davvolinni-ui
version.changelog: Improved persistent worker discovery and large-library scan performance. Prevented slow membership cleanup and redundant post-scan filter rebuilding. Repaired roots marked current despite missing generated tags. Corrected vocal ad-lib and sung-phrase classification behavior.

version.name: 1.0.0-rc8
version.author: davvolinni-ui
version.changelog: Added direct ReaDrumXT batch loading from ordered audio selections. Fixed FX Chain insertion and guarded FX Chain/Track Template insertion behind deliberate double-clicks. Improved database-worker startup, locking, adoption, and cold-scan recovery.

version.name: 1.0.0-rc9
version.author: davvolinni-ui
version.changelog: Added configurable native external dragging and one-shot drag behavior. Improved folder-row contrast and resizable media preview panels. Updated the native audio preview companion.
